description: Full details of one Philippine scholarship by id (from ph_search_scholarships or ph_list_scholarships): eligibility, benefits, application period, how to apply, official and source URLs, and the date it was last checked. Fields the official page does not state are null.

name: ph_get_scholarship
title: Get scholarship details
